==Purpose of template==
Create an external link.
*For linking to {{TVlink}}, see {{tl|TVlink}}.
*For linking to {{TLlink}}, see {{tl|TLlink}}, {{tl|TIDB}}, and {{tl|TIDBKW}}.
*For linking to other Fandom wikis, see {{tl|Wlink}}.
*For linking to {{Wiki}}, see {{tl|Wiki}}.

==How to use==

<pre>{{Link}}
{{Link|url}}
{{Link|url|display text}}</pre>

==Examples==


{|
!Code
!Result
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{Link}}</nowiki></code>
|              {{Link}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{Link|[[Robert Jordan|RJ]]}}</nowiki></code>
|              {{Link|[[Robert Jordan|RJ]]}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{Link|https://wot.fandom.com/wiki/Robert_Jordan|Robert Jordan}}</nowiki></code>
|              {{Link|https://wot.fandom.com/wiki/Robert_Jordan|Robert Jordan}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{Link|https://wheeloftime.fandom.com/wiki/Robert_Jordan|Robert Jordan}}</nowiki></code>
|              {{Link|https://wheeloftime.fandom.com/wiki/Robert_Jordan|Robert Jordan}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{Link|[[w:c:wheeloftime:Robert Jordan]]}}</nowiki></code>
|              {{Link|[[w:c:wheeloftime:Robert Jordan]]}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{Link|https://dragonmount.com/blogs/blog/4-robert-jordans-blog/}}</nowiki></code>

|-

|              {{Link|https://dragonmount.com/blogs/blog/4-robert-jordans-blog/|Robert Jordan's blog}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{Link|https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Jordan|Robert Jordan}}</nowiki></code>
|              {{Link|https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Jordan|Robert Jordan}}
